requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport.receive_messages method is returning a coroutine instead of an async iterator, causing 'async for' to fail with 'TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine' errors.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method should return an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be properly consumed with 'async for' loops. The method should properly yield messages from the transport's async stream.

requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method is not properly handling async iteration when the prompt is an AsyncIterable, causing issues with streaming functionality.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method should properly iterate over AsyncIterable prompts and send each message to stdin, handling potential exceptions gracefully without breaking the transport lifecycle.

requirement.description: The disconnect method in ClaudeSDKClient is not properly closing the transport's stdin stream, leading to connection issues in some test cases.
requirement.contract: The disconnect method should ensure proper cleanup of all transport resources including stdin streams, especially when dealing with streaming connections.

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query method is not correctly handling the async iterator flow from the transport's receive_messages method.
requirement.contract: The process_query method should properly yield messages from transport.receive_messages() to ensure the async iteration works correctly throughout the call stack.
